about: Every line of user-facing text that names a version, reviewed. A1.09 fails on a line that names a version and is not here, and on an entry whose line no longer exists — an edit to a reviewed line asks for a fresh review. Keyed on the line's text (whitespace-normalised), not its number. The changelog and frontend/lib/releases.ts are version histories by design and are not scanned. See RELEASE.md, Phase 1.
